The '''Reclaimed Mining Site''' was a large [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.2}}</ref> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] rebels known as the [[Hidden Chain]] coalition settled on the Ruhnuk, using the abandoned mining facility as a base. Soon, they were tracked by the opposing [[Mandalore the Avenger]]'s [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|faction]] and a battle ensued, known as the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]].<ref name="TOR:SoR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>
